subject: English
question_text: Read the following text and fill in each gap with a
stimulus: suitable word based on the information of the text.15 = 5 The culture of India is one of the oldest and unique in the world. In India, there is amazing cultural diversity throughout the country. The South, North and North-east have their own distinct cultures and almost every state has carved out its own cultural distinction. There is hardly any culture in the world that is as varied and unique as India. There are 17 major languages and 844 dialects used by the people of India. Thus, India is a tourists' delight. The Taj Mahal, Fatehpur Sikri, the Qutab Minar and the Red Fort are a few of the many wonders which attract people from all over the wrold. Kashmir has been deseribed as a paradise on earth. The country of mountains, valleys, deserts, rivers and lake offer the richness of a mini world within a single country. [Unit-6; Lesson-4(A)] There is hardly any culture in the world that is as varied as India. The culture diversity of India is (a) ⎯ . In fact, it is a (b) ⎯ one. Each state is culturally (c) ⎯ . Different languages, dialects and culture have made India a (d) ⎯ of tourists. In a word, India is a (e) ⎯ world. Read the passage and answer the questions 4 and 5. APJ Abdul Kalam was born on 15 October 1931 at the South Indian state of Tamil Nadu and received honorary doctorates from about 30 universities globally. In the year 1981, the | 172 Government of India presented him the nation's highest civilian honour, the Padma Bhushan and then again, the Padma Vibhushan in 1990 and the Bharat Ratna in 1997. Before Kalam, there have been only two president-Sarvepally Radhakrishnan and Zakir Hussain- to have received the Bharat Ratna before being appointed to the highest office in India. If you read more about the life history of Dr APJ Abdul Kalam, you will know that he was also the first scientist and bachelor to occupy the seat of the Rashtrapati Bhavan. His perspectives on important topics have been enunciated by him in the book 'India 2020'. It highlights the action plans that will help develop the country into a knowledge superpower by the time 2020. One thing for which he received ample kudos is his unambiguous statement that India needs to play a more assertive role in international relations.
